statement: Every finite simple undirected graph on exactly 24 vertices in which one vertex has degree 5 and each of the other 23 vertices has degree 3 contains a simple cycle whose length is one of 4, 8, or 16.
contribution: A computer-assisted exact finite exclusion of the first non-cubic degree-excess-two family, obtained by a complete three-case neighborhood reduction, exhaustive nauty generation of residual graphs, exhaustive attachment-orbit enumeration, and separately implemented component cross-checks. This does not settle the frozen minimum-degree-at-least-three assertion.
